summary: Cadeler A/S filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated 21 September 2026 announcing that its Nexra offshore wind service platform and Vattenfall Vindkraft AB signed a non-binding memorandum of understanding to explore next-generation operations and maintenance solutions, focused on Major Component Exchange capabilities. No price, stake, consideration, premium or closing date is stated; the MoU creates no definitive obligations or capital commitment. No board recommendation or financial advisor is named. The arrangement is a commercial collaboration only, not a change-of-control or capital event, with no regulatory clock; the arbitrable angle is nil, and any follow-on binding contracts or JV formation would be the items to watch.
